name: G-P (Globalization Partners)
summary: G-P employs people in 180+ countries without a local entity and generates contracts checked by a compliance engine. Employer of record starts at $599 per employee per month, with no minimum contract length and volume discounts through sales.

evidence.capability: employment in countries without an entity

facts.text: G-P says it can employ people in 180+ countries and pay in 150+ currencies.
G-P's FAQ says the platform fee covers tax filings and local payroll processing, while statutory taxes are separate and vary by country.
G-P's FAQ states there is no minimum contract length for EOR hires.

plans.name: Employer of Record
plans.notes: Starting price. Volume discounts are available through sales

hiddenCosts: Statutory taxes and employer costs are separate from the platform fee.
Billing schedule and other fees are not published; they come with a proposal.
Add-ons such as an Employee Assistance Program cost extra.
